### Post-Audit Bug Fixes (DONE)
- [x] **CORS regression**: Audit removed `cors({ origin: "*" })` (P8 #72) but Vite dev server (`localhost:5173`) and API server (`127.0.0.1:PORT`) are different origins — SSE `EventSource` blocked by browser. Added CORS headers back inline for dev mode.
- [x] **Scan progress stuck at 23/23**: Activity log progress counter only tracked `scanProgress.completed` (store-phase only). During AI scan, it stayed at 23/23. Fixed by deriving progress from `refreshState.projects` Map which tracks both `storeStatus` and `llmStatus`. Shows LLM progress with "AI scan" label when AI phase is active.
- [x] **Meaningless What Now badge**: Badge showed count from `computeActions()` (per-project alerts), but What Now tab only displays portfolio analysis (1 recommendation + secondary picks + insights) — no action list. Removed badge since the count didn't correspond to visible content.
- [x] **Unhandled rejection logging**: Added `process.on("unhandledRejection")` to `server.ts` so rogue promise rejections get logged instead of silently crashing the process.

## Key Architecture Decisions
- **`bootstrap-db.mjs` is the schema source of truth**: No Prisma migrations — raw SQL CREATE TABLE + ALTER TABLE
- **`metaJson`/`extrasJson` for extensibility**: New scan/LLM fields go into JSON columns automatically
- **`deriveConfig` as tunable config**: All thresholds and weights in `src/config/derive-config.ts`
- **`momentumRawMax` = 70**: Only one recency tier can be earned at a time
- **Deprecated Llm columns kept as fallbacks**: `purpose`, `risksJson`/`recommendationsJson`
- **CORS in dev mode only**: Inline headers (no `cors` package) — production serves SPA from same origin
